requirements.description: Big Six Wheel exposes the approved 54-segment profile, seven wager targets, deterministic result seam, and documented net payout table through its engine and browser surface.
requirements.notes: Allocated by GitHub issue #77 for issue #86; focused tests cover all legal targets, segment boundaries, normalization, payout calculation, and issue #1013 shared-lifecycle ownership without changing the 54-segment profile.

requirements.description: Authenticated sessions own isolated reload-safe Big Six Wheel state, recent settlements, and canonical route restoration.
requirements.notes: Normal-user session context overrides caller-supplied player ids, settled round history survives backend restart, and shared route teardown prevents stale asynchronous repaint after navigation.

requirements.description: Each Big Six spin uses one aggregate ledger wager debit and at most one settlement credit with request-fingerprint conflict detection and exactly-once retry recovery.
requirements.notes: SimpleWagerGame owns both aggregate ledger movements and crash recovery; stable historical round and ledger action keys keep exact retries safe while changed wagers fail closed.

requirements.description: The Big Six Wheel surface provides complete English and Russian copy, responsive ready/spinning/settled states, cumulative forward wheel motion, delayed result reveal, and reduced-motion-safe timer lifecycle behavior.
requirements.notes: Acceptance evidence covers both locales, all four named viewports, active and settled play, cumulative pointer alignment, reduced motion, canonical route restoration, and the issue #1013 external stylesheet identity.

requirements.description: Catalog, contract, browser, and long-suite discovery automatically include Big Six Wheel with requirement, module, version, and visual evidence traceability.
requirements.notes: The descriptor uses sort order 90 and the normalized tests.game_drivers.big_six_wheel:play driver reference reserved by issue #77.

requirements.description: Every normal Big Six spin advances cumulatively through at least six clockwise turns, keeps the authoritative outcome hidden and wager controls locked until presentation settles, and lands the fixed pointer on the server-selected segment without snap, reset, reverse, or stale lifecycle state.
requirements.notes: The exact-head long gate performs 100 consecutive real UI spins at each governed viewport, covers EN/RU, resize, background/foreground lifecycle suspension, four-times CPU throttling, reduced motion, cache-safe production asset reload, scroll reachability, and paired top/stage/lower visual review. Issue #1013 retains the strict secure bsw-prefixed identity and motion timer scope while delegating route ownership.

requirements.description: Every Big Six Wheel settled-history publication merges its committed round into provider-current state, preserves unrelated sibling fields and distinct concurrent rounds, accepts an identical result idempotently, and rejects changed-meaning or divergent same-request state.
requirements.notes: SimpleWagerGame now owns atomic publication while the adapter preserves the frozen direct-row state shape, 54-segment profile, entropy seam, and deterministic ledger action keys. Multiworker activation stays blocked because state, ledger, and history remain separate boundaries.

requirements.description: Big Six Wheel delegates its one-shot wager, committed entropy recovery, optional settlement credit, replay lookup, and provider-current history publication to SimpleWagerGame while preserving the frozen v1 client_request_id, round identity, public round, state history, and ledger evidence semantics.
requirements.notes: The game service contains no direct GameSettlementGateway construction or apply_once call. Compatibility adapters dual-read historical debit proof and dual-write canonical evidence without changing the additive v1 contract.
